verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents Jupyter as a connection method under its instance-connect guides, and an Instance Portal that creates Cloudflare tunnels for each open port. It also offers key-based SSH access, which remote IDEs could use. However, nothing in the evidence shows a one-step Jupyter launch or a direct VS Code/Cursor integration, so the IDE half rests only on generic SSH. Missing for 10: evidence of a one-click Jupyter open flow, a documented VS Code/Cursor remote-connect workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
